¹ **Usage notes**

- **八號風球** — When it is raised, offices and schools close.

The **classifier** is the measure word used when counting or pointing: 一**部**電腦, 呢**間**醫院. See [Number + Classifier + Noun](../grammar/number-classifier.md).
